title: Gotrade Daily: Fed Minutes Test the S&P 500 Record
summary: The S&P 500 and Nasdaq closed at records ahead of tonight's Fed minutes. Watchlist: NVDA, AMD, MU, APO, LEVI.
body_markdown:
## Tonight's Watchlist


Stock Movement What to Watch


[NVDA](https://www.heygotrade.com/en/us-stock/nvda/) +0.14% Tuesday at $239.24 An FT report says SpaceX is seeking a $40 billion loan to buy Nvidia chips. Watch for any update on the deal.


[AMD](https://www.heygotrade.com/en/us-stock/amd/) +2.80% Tuesday at $649.42 CEO Lisa Su is set to meet Samsung's chip head as the memory crunch persists. Watch for news from the meeting.


[MU](https://www.heygotrade.com/en/us-stock/mu/) -1.73% Tuesday at $1,045.56 Samsung reports preliminary Q3 results on Thursday (Oct 8). Watch memory stocks ahead of the release.


[APO](https://www.heygotrade.com/en/us-stock/apo/) +0.52% Tuesday at $115.95 Reported to lead SpaceX's $40 billion financing. Watch for official confirmation from the parties.


[LEVI](https://www.heygotrade.com/en/us-stock/levi/) +1.28% Tuesday at $20.53 Scheduled to report earnings after the close tonight. Watch the results and company guidance.


Source: closing prices from[Nasdaq](https://www.nasdaq.com/market-activity/stocks) . What to Watch:[Seeking Alpha/FT](https://seekingalpha.com/news/4650788-spacex-seeks-40b-in-apollo-led-deal-to-buy-nvidia-chips-ft-reports) (NVDA, APO),[Bloomberg](https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2026-10-07/amd-s-su-to-meet-samsung-s-chip-head-as-memory-crunch-persists) (AMD),[Investing.com](https://www.investing.com/news/stock-market-news/samsung-q3-earnings-preview-record-profit-expected-but-margin-outlook-in-focus-93CH-4935549) (MU),[Nasdaq](https://www.nasdaq.com/market-activity/earnings) (LEVI).


## Tonight's Key Events


### Minutes of the Fed's September meeting


The Fed releases the minutes of its September 15-16 meeting tonight, per the[Fed's official calendar](https://www.federalreserve.gov/monetarypolicy/fomccalendars.htm) . According to[Investing.com](https://www.investing.com/news/stock-market-news/asia-stocks-fall-despite-wall-street-records-as-rising-oil-yields-weigh-4935558) , markets have cut the odds of an October rate hike to around 20%, while a December hike remains heavily priced. Investors will look to the minutes for clues on the rate path.


### SpaceX and demand for Nvidia chips


According to an FT report cited by[Seeking Alpha](https://seekingalpha.com/news/4650788-spacex-seeks-40b-in-apollo-led-deal-to-buy-nvidia-chips-ft-reports) , SpaceX is seeking $40 billion in financing led by **Apollo Global Management ([APO](https://www.heygotrade.com/en/us-stock/apo/) )** to buy **Nvidia ([NVDA](https://www.heygotrade.com/en/us-stock/nvda/) )** chips. According to[The Motley Fool](https://www.fool.com/investing/2026/10/06/nvidia-is-about-4-from-becoming-the-first-usd6-trillion-company-history-says-the-milestone-itself-tells-you-little/) , Nvidia was worth around $5.8 trillion at Monday's close, about 4% shy of $6 trillion.
